title: Expectation of a finite sum
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $I$ be finite sets, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f_i:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ for each $i\in I$. Then the expectation of the pointwise sum is the sum of the expectations: $\mathbb{E}_p[\sum_{i\in I}f_i]=\sum_{i\in I}\mathbb{E}_p[f_i]$.
hypotheses_covered: a real-valued function on the sample space for each index
